full_tooltip_text: Generate: {generated_resource} Maelstrom | Hurls a bolt of lightning at the target. It deals {damage_pct} weapon damage as Lightning. | Primary | Unlocked at level 1.
notes: Proc coefficient 1.0 (draft v1.4)

full_tooltip_text: Generate: {generated_resource} Maelstrom | Strikes the target instantly with a jolt of elemental fire. Deals {damage_pct:hit} weapon damage as Fire and makes the target Burning for another {damage_pct:dot} weapon damage as Fire over {dot_duration_seconds} seconds. Can be on any number of enemies. | Base Flame Shock, the Lava Shock rune and Fire-Attuned Primal Shock make enemies Burning. The Frost, Earth and Static Shock runes replace the burn. Lava Burst deals more damage to any Burning enemy. | Primary | Unlocked at level 3.
notes: Proc coefficient 1.0; burn ticks 0.1 (base burn and the Lava Shock burn; draft v1.4). The instant-hit generator and the default Burning source; each rune turns it into a different elemental shock (draft v1.4). The draft's line that Lava Burst always critically strikes any Burning enemy is replaced by the flat Burning bonus on Lava Burst (this brief, change 1)

full_tooltip_text: Generate: {generated_resource} Maelstrom | Cracks a whip of raw elemental force from your hand that lashes every enemy in a {radius_yards}-yard, {cone_angle_degrees}° cone in front of you. It deals {damage_pct} weapon damage as Physical. | Primary | Unlocked at level 9.
notes: Proc coefficient 0.6; Searing Lash burn ticks 0.1 (draft v1.4). The short and mid range cone generator, shaped like Crippling Wave but cast at range; the base is Earth (Physical), runes change its element and add one simple effect (draft v1.4)

full_tooltip_text: Generate: {generated_resource} Maelstrom | Hurls a lance of frost-branded ice that pierces every enemy in a line. It deals {damage_pct} weapon damage as Cold to each and Chills them by {chill_pct} for {chill_duration_seconds} seconds. | Primary | Unlocked at level 17.
notes: Draft name Frostbrand Bolt; renamed Frost Lance so the Elemental Weapon imbue keeps the name Frostbrand (this brief, change 4). Proc coefficient 0.8 (draft v1.4)

full_tooltip_text: Cost: {cost_resource} Maelstrom | Releases a bolt of lightning that hits the target for {damage_pct} weapon damage as Lightning and jumps to up to {target_count} more enemies within {radius_yards} yards. Each jump deals the same damage. | Secondary | Unlocked at level 2.
notes: Name Chain Lightning, also a Wizard Electrocute rune, kept (the designer, q-1021-130). Proc coefficient 0.5 (draft v1.4)

full_tooltip_text: Cost: {cost_resource} Maelstrom | Hurls molten lava at the target for {damage_pct} weapon damage as Fire. Deals {damage_bonus_pct} more damage to Burning enemies, meaning enemies affected by any Fire damage-over-time or burn effect from you. | Secondary | Unlocked at level 8.
notes: Proc coefficient 1.0 (draft v1.4). The draft's always-critical-strike on Burning enemies is a flat damage bonus (this brief, change 1; the 50% is proposed, README)

full_tooltip_text: Cost: {cost_resource} Maelstrom | Shakes the ground in a {radius_yards}-yard radius at the target location. Deals {damage_pct} weapon damage as Physical over {dot_duration_seconds} seconds. Each tick has a {proc_chance_pct} chance to Knock Down enemies for {duration_seconds} second. Only one Earthquake can be active at a time; casting another moves it and refreshes the duration. | Secondary | Unlocked at level 18.
notes: Name Earthquake, also a Barbarian skill, kept (the designer, q-1021-130). Proc coefficient 0.15 per tick (draft v1.4)

full_tooltip_text: Cost: {cost_resource} Maelstrom | Fires a blast of pure elemental energy for {damage_pct} weapon damage in the element of your current Attunement. It also grants Elemental Mastery for {duration_seconds} seconds: +{crit_chance_pct} critical hit chance. Elemental Blast keeps your current Attunement (Prismatic Cycle advances it). | Secondary | Unlocked at level 24.
notes: Proc coefficient 1.0 (draft v1.4). The one skill whose element always follows the Attunement, the class mechanic showcase (draft v1.4). The sheet's element was Attuned: the record carries Lightning, the Attunement a Shaman starts in, and the skill follows the current Attunement when it is cast (2b)

full_tooltip_text: Generate: {generated_resource} Maelstrom | Cooldown: {cooldown_seconds} seconds | Calls down a thunderclap around you. It deals {damage_pct} weapon damage as Lightning to all enemies within {radius_yards} yards, Knocks them Back, and Slows them by {slow_pct} for {slow_duration_seconds} seconds. | Defensive | Unlocked at level 5.
notes: Proc coefficient 0.5 (draft v1.4)

full_tooltip_text: Cooldown: {cooldown_seconds} seconds | Turns you into a spectral wolf for {duration_seconds} seconds. You gain {movement_speed_pct} movement speed, are immune to Slows and Roots, and can move through enemies. Casting any other skill ends the form. | Defensive | Unlocked at level 11.
notes: The stock Ghost Wolf form (this brief, Builds on)

full_tooltip_text: Cooldown: {cooldown_seconds} seconds | Wraps you in {charge_count} elemental charges. Each hit you take uses up a charge, lowers that hit's damage by {damage_reduction_pct}, and strikes the attacker for {damage_pct} weapon damage as Lightning (at most once per {interval_seconds} second). Lasts {duration_seconds} seconds. Only one Elemental Shield can be active at a time; the rune decides its element and the buff it gives. | Defensive | Unlocked at level 6.
notes: Proc coefficient 0.3 (draft v1.4). Base element Lightning, not the draft's Earth (this brief, change 7); the draft's "living stone" wording is dropped with it

full_tooltip_text: Cooldown: {cooldown_seconds} seconds | Fires a shock that deals {damage_pct} weapon damage as Lightning. It removes enemy shields and empowered states, such as the Shielding, Reflects Damage, Juggernaut and Illusionist effects on elites and Rift Guardian shields. Removing an effect generates {gain_resource} Maelstrom. | Defensive | Unlocked at level 19.
notes: Proc coefficient 1.0 (draft v1.4). Moved from Ancestral to Defensive in the draft (v1.2)

full_tooltip_text: Cost: {cost_resource} Maelstrom | Places a Searing Totem at your feet that shoots a firebolt at the nearest enemy within {radius_yards} yards every {interval_seconds} second. Each bolt deals {damage_pct} weapon damage as Fire. Lasts {duration_seconds} seconds. | Totems | Unlocked at level 4.
notes: Proc coefficient 0.25 (draft v1.4). The Maelstrom totem; the stock fire totem slot. One totem of its type at a time: placing it again replaces the one standing, and it is placed at the caster's feet, never at range (this brief, change 5)

full_tooltip_text: Cooldown: {cooldown_seconds} seconds | Places a totem at your feet that Slows enemies within {radius_yards} yards by {slow_pct}. Lasts {duration_seconds} seconds. | Totems | Unlocked at level 10.
notes: The stock earth totem slot. One totem of its type at a time, placed at the caster's feet (this brief, change 5)

full_tooltip_text: Cooldown: {cooldown_seconds} seconds | Places a totem at your feet that heals you and allies within {radius_yards} yards for {life_regen_pct} of maximum Life per second. Lasts {duration_seconds} seconds. | Totems | Unlocked at level 16.
notes: The stock water totem slot. One totem of its type at a time, placed at the caster's feet (this brief, change 5)

full_tooltip_text: Cooldown: {cooldown_seconds} seconds | Places a totem at your feet that gives you and allies within {radius_yards} yards +{attack_speed_pct} attack speed. Your Primary skills have a {proc_chance_pct} chance to cast twice (a free cast echo). Lasts {duration_seconds} seconds. | Totems | Unlocked at level 23.
notes: The stock air totem slot (the draft renamed Windfury Totem so the Windfury name belongs to the imbue). One totem of its type at a time, placed at the caster's feet (this brief, change 5)

full_tooltip_text: Cost: {cost_resource} Maelstrom | Imbues your weapon with elemental power. Like a Monk's Mantra, each imbue has a Passive effect that is always on while the imbue is active and an Activate effect when you cast it. The imbue is permanent until replaced, and only one imbue can be active at a time: the rune you choose decides which imbue it is, and casting with a different rune swaps it. | Passive (base imbue): Your skills deal {damage_bonus_pct:passive} more damage and generate {regen_pct} more Maelstrom. | Activate (base imbue): For {duration_seconds} seconds, your skills deal an additional {damage_bonus_pct:activate} more damage. | Ancestral | Unlocked at level 15.
notes: The Mantra shape. Casting spends 50 Maelstrom and triggers the activation; below 50 Maelstrom the cast sets the imbue and its passive; the activation runs on Maelstrom alone (no cooldown) and a new activation refreshes the 3-second window, one activation at a time (draft v1.4)

full_tooltip_text: Cooldown: {cooldown_seconds} seconds | Binds up to {target_count} enemies within {radius_yards} yards of the target together with spirit chains for {duration_seconds} seconds. {damage_share_pct} of the damage you deal to one linked enemy is also dealt to every other linked enemy. Linked enemies also take {damage_pct} weapon damage as Physical per second. Elites and bosses can be linked but receive only half of the shared damage. Shared damage copies the final damage of the original hit, crit included, and lands once as a proc-free echo. | Ancestral | Unlocked at level 7.
notes: Proc coefficient 0.2 (draft v1.4). New, no D3 precedent for the damage sharing; balance note 16 is its rule: shared damage is a resolved copy of the original hit, one crit roll, zero procs, zero Area Damage, a single share. Role: trash killer, weak against lone bosses (draft v1.4)

full_tooltip_text: Cooldown: {cooldown_seconds} seconds | Calls {spawn_count} ancestor spirits that appear behind you for {duration_seconds} seconds and immediately recast your last Secondary skill at your target. While they remain, each time you cast a Secondary skill, each ancestor recasts it for {damage_share_pct} of its damage. Recasts copy the rune, element and damage bonuses of your cast and are free. Your own cast keeps the Overcharge bonus, and cast triggers (Lightning Overload, Totemic Resonance, the Fire Elemental echo) fire on your own casts. The ancestors are spirits of your spellcraft: untargetable, invulnerable, and scaled entirely by your skill damage. | Ancestral | Unlocked at level 28.
notes: Element of the copied skill (draft v1.4). Skill damage from the caster, not pets, and they do not copy Overcharge (this brief, change 7). Role: Rift Guardian killer, saved for the burst window (draft v1.4). The sheet's element was Copied: the record carries Physical (a skill that names none), and the copy takes the copied skill's element when it is cast
source_url: draft v1.4 (section 3.5, Call of the Ancestors)

full_tooltip_text: Cooldown: {cooldown_seconds} seconds | Releases {projectile_count} spectral wolves that run {radius_yards} yards in a line, pass through enemies, and deal {damage_pct} weapon damage as Physical to everything they touch. Then they vanish. | Ancestral | Unlocked at level 22.
notes: Proc coefficient 0.33 per wolf (draft v1.4). A projectile wave: the untargetable wolves sweep the line once and scale with the skill damage (this brief, change 7)

full_tooltip_text: Cooldown: {cooldown_seconds} seconds | You and all allies within {radius_yards} yards gain +{attack_speed_pct} attack speed and +{movement_speed_pct} movement speed for {duration_seconds} seconds. Casting it again refreshes the duration; it never stacks. | Primal | Unlocked at level 14.
notes: Affects allies; refreshes and never stacks, no Sated debuff (this brief, change 4). A group buff on the War Cry shape (this brief, Builds on)

full_tooltip_text: Cooldown: {cooldown_seconds} seconds | Calls a Greater Fire Elemental that hovers at your side as an extension of your will. It follows your lead, stays untargetable, and scales with your skill damage. It burns enemies within {radius_yards} yards of you for {damage_pct:aura} weapon damage as Fire per second. Each time you cast a Secondary skill, it echoes the cast with a Fire Blast at your target for {damage_pct:echo} weapon damage as Fire. Lasts {duration_seconds} seconds. | Primal | Unlocked at level 20.
notes: Proc coefficient 0.25 for the aura, 1.0 for the echo (draft v1.4). Skill damage from the caster like Hydra, not a pet; both elementals may be up at once (this brief, change 7)

full_tooltip_text: Cooldown: {cooldown_seconds} seconds | A towering Earth Elemental rises at the target location. It is invulnerable and stays in place. It stomps every {interval_seconds} seconds for {damage_pct} weapon damage as Physical within {radius_yards} yards. While it is active, you take {damage_reduction_pct} less damage. Lasts {duration_seconds} seconds. | Primal | Unlocked at level 26.
notes: Proc coefficient 0.5 (draft v1.4). No taunt: it holds enemies by hitting them (this brief, change 3); skill damage from the caster, not a pet (this brief, change 7)

full_tooltip_text: Cooldown: {cooldown_seconds} seconds | You become an elemental Ascendant, and your skill bar stays the same. Damage dealt increases by {damage_bonus_pct}, Maelstrom generation doubles, and each Primary skill cast also fires an elemental bolt at {target_count} more enemies for {damage_share_pct} of its damage. Lasts {duration_seconds} seconds. Each rune picks an element and empowers it. | Primal | Unlocked at level 30.
